panel.coachEngine: Coach item from the Learning Coach engine
panel.nothing: Nothing needs your attention this period.
panel.rule: At most 7 items: expiring qualifications first, then things waiting for you, then suggestions. Each item says why it is here.

panel.preparing: Preparing this period's digest from your records…

bell.title: Digest · {period}
bell.notYet: Open My Kafa'a to see this period's digest.

settings.title: Digest and nudges
settings.intro: One in-app digest per period with up to 7 items: what expires, what waits for you and what fits you. Each item links to the page where you act.
settings.enabled: Send me a digest and nudges
settings.enabledHint: Turning this off stops new digests. Statutory expiry notices are not affected.
settings.quietHint: No new digest is built between these hours (Abu Dhabi time)
settings.expiryLocked: Always included: renewing before expiry is a safety requirement
settings.note: In-app only: Kafa'a sends no email in this demo.

admin.rules: At most {max} items per digest; qualifications and mirrored licences within {days} days; opportunities posted in the last {opp} days with a match of {pct}% or more. Admins and auditors see aggregates only: every count under 10 is suppressed.
admin.openRateSub: Latest period with 10 or more digests
admin.mutedNote: People who muted at least one kind: {n}.
admin.futureRules: Future-skills nudges (since {date}): at most {cap} per digest, after every other kind; the 8 published rules are listed below.

future.title: Future-skills nudges
future.intro: Since week 42 of 2026 your digest also tells you when your role's 2030 profile changes, a skill rises in your area, a fast-changing skill may slip, a goal is due, an AI system you use needs a higher rung, or a new gig or pathway fits you. At most 2 per digest; you can mute them in your nudge settings.
future.empty: The published rules are not available right now.
future.method: Every nudge is a published rule over your own records: no score about you is stored, and nothing is shown to anyone else.
